summary: Frontend-only visual regression verification for two Home page image fixes on Consecrated Hands site. Both fixes confirmed working on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). No layout regression observed.

verifications.visual_result: PASS - Child's head and face fully visible on both desktop and mobile. Headline 'Consecrated to guide the ones who need it most.' remains readable over the gradient overlay.

PASS - Faith cards now upright and readable: 'FIVE THINGS GOD WANTS YOU TO REMEMBER IN TRYING TIMES', 'YOU CAME TO MIND', and Scripture verse card are all right-side up. White headline 'We show them the lies — and we tell them the Truth.' plus body copy and Psalm 139:13-14 verse remain legible with drop-shadow over the bg-charcoal/30 overlay on both desktop and mobile.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Home hero uses object-[50%_22%] positioning; Truth section uses rotate-180 on faith-cards img with bg-charcoal/30 overlay + drop-shadow on text. Both verified visually on desktop and mobile. Site uses Lenis smooth scroll - use element.scrollIntoView() to reach Truth section reliably in playwright tests.
